heading: Featured Projects
subheading: Some of the projects I've worked on

items.title: Bracketology – Fantasy Gaming Platform
items.challenge: Build an enterprise-grade fantasy gaming platform supporting 10,000+ daily active users with prediction-based competitions, league management, and real-time scoring systems.
items.solution: Engineered a scalable backend architecture with a dual-currency virtual economy (Coins and USD-redeemable Bucks), Redis caching, Sidekiq job queuing, payment gateway APIs, and SEON fraud detection. Deployed on highly available AWS infrastructure with auto-scaling and disaster recovery.

impacts.description: Traffic spike handling during peak events

items.title: Northstar – Recycler-to-Company Marketplace
items.challenge: Modernize a legacy marketplace application connecting recyclers to companies, addressing frontend UI bugs and backend performance issues.
items.solution: Diagnosed and resolved frontend UI bugs across multiple views for visual consistency. Rewrote the entire application in Golang for the backend and plain HTML/CSS for the frontend, significantly reducing complexity and improving page load performance.

items.title: SPARKFINCH – Full-Stack Application Enhancement
items.challenge: Stabilize and enhance a full-stack application suffering from numerous frontend and backend bugs, while rapidly shipping new features.
items.solution: Resolved 30+ frontend and backend bugs improving application stability by 45%, leveraging AI-assisted development tools. Deployed 8+ new features to production using Django framework and GenAI-augmented development workflows.
